create_sana_sprint_pipeline: create a SanaSprintPipeline instance from a pretrained Efficient-Large-Model checkpoint with bfloat16 dtype
run_sana_sprint_generation: run the SanaSprintPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a text prompt using SCM scheduler with 2 inference steps
encode_sana_sprint_prompt: encode a text prompt into Gemma text encoder hidden states with clean caption preprocessing and attention mask
prepare_sana_sprint_latents: prepare random latents for SanaSprintPipeline diffusion with configurable batch size, height, width, and dtype
configure_sana_sprint_scheduler: configure DPMSolverMultistepScheduler timesteps with custom max_timesteps and intermediate_timesteps for SCM denoising
